about_the_game:
《Fish Swarm: Within Inches》
Gather your swarm in the crevices of the abyss and fight for survival.

Core Features

🌊 Unique “Fish Swarm” Life System

  • Life is Your Army: Your health is the size of your swarm. Taking damage means losing members, while healing brings new companions. Every battle directly affects the scale of your school.

  • Dynamic Formation: A large swarm naturally forms spectacular flowing formations that shift with movement and combat, making each playthrough a unique visual experience.

⚔️ Customizable “Weapon Fish” Evolution

  • Evolve Your Fangs: Special “weapon fish” within the swarm are responsible for attacks. Like building a deck, collect, upgrade, and combine various weapon fish (e.g., water-jet “Arrow Fish”, explosive “Bomb Fish”, swift-slashing “Blade Fish”) to create a unique combat style.

  • Deep Roguelike Building: Each run offers different evolution options and weapon fish combinations. Experiment with endless builds to find your ultimate swarm configuration.

🌀 Limit Survival in “Within Inches”

  • Intense Compact Combat: Battles take place in confined waters. Maneuver within inches, directing the swarm to evade deadly attacks while seizing opportunities to devour enemies and grow.

  • Endless Abyssal Challenges: Face waves of enemies growing ever stronger—from tiny water insects to massive deep-sea monsters. Careful positioning and strategy are key to surviving these cruel waters.

🎣 High Replay Value

  • Multiple Swarm Types: Unlock swarms with different starting weapons and traits (e.g., the “Shooter Swarm” with ranged weapons or the “Shield-Scale Swarm” focused on melee survival) for fresh challenges.

  • Massive Upgrades & Items: Collect hundreds of enhancements and evolutionary abilities that interact in surprising ways, ensuring every run is full of variability and excitement.

Ready to take on the challenge beneath the waves? Transform the instinct to survive into the will to attack, and let the name of your swarm echo through the abyss!

Evolve different weaponized fish breeds, and combine abilities to transform your school from vulnerable prey into an unstoppable force that dominates the abyss. Survive relentless waves of aquatic creatures.
